documents.title: Quick Start Guide
documents.summary: Step-by-step guide to start Clipstream platform in 5 minutes. Covers Docker setup, backend startup, testing swipe interface, and API testing.

documents.title: Collision-less Embeddings Guide
documents.summary: Complete guide to the collision-less embedding system using SHA256 hashing and FAISS indexing. Covers API usage, performance benchmarks, and production deployment.

documents.title: Infinite Scroll Feed API
documents.summary: Cursor-based pagination API for infinite scroll feed. Excludes seen videos, supports ML ranking, and handles prefetching.

documents.title: Real-time ML Feedback
documents.summary: Real-time ML feedback system using Server-Sent Events (SSE) and Redis Pub/Sub. Provides instant preference updates as users interact with videos.

documents.title: TikTok Video Ingestion
documents.summary: Guide to downloading and ingesting real TikTok videos using yt-dlp. Covers metadata extraction, CDN upload, and batch processing.

documents.title: ML Ranking Algorithm
documents.summary: TikTok-style 3-component ML ranking algorithm: User Interest (60%) + Video Quality (30%) + Exploration (10%). Includes diversity re-ranking.

documents.title: Database Schema
documents.summary: Complete database schema with 9 tables: video, user, event, model, likes, follows, comment, earnings, report. Optimized indexes for performance.

documents.title: Scaling Guide
documents.summary: Guide to scaling Clipstream to TikTok-level traffic. Covers FAISS sharding, Redis clustering, CDN deployment, and event buffering.

documents.title: API Endpoints Reference
documents.summary: Complete API reference with all endpoints, request/response formats, and examples.

documents.title: Testing Guide
documents.summary: Multi-user testing scenarios for ML algorithm validation. Covers automated tests, manual testing, and performance benchmarks.

documents.title: Troubleshooting Guide
documents.summary: Common issues and solutions. Covers Docker, Redis, SSE, video playback, and performance problems.

documents.title: System Architecture
documents.summary: High-level architecture overview showing all components and their interactions.

faq.question: How do I start the platform?
faq.answer: Run `bash START_TIKTOK_PLATFORM.sh` from the project root.

faq.question: How fast is the embedding search?
faq.answer: ~2ms for 1,000 videos, ~50ms for 1 million videos using FAISS.

faq.question: Can I use real TikTok videos?
faq.answer: Yes, use the TikTok scraper with yt-dlp. See TikTok Ingestion guide.

faq.question: How does the ML algorithm work?
faq.answer: 3-component scoring: User Interest (60%) + Video Quality (30%) + Exploration (10%).

faq.question: Is there collision in embeddings?
faq.answer: No, SHA256 hashing ensures zero collisions (probability ~0%).

faq.question: How do I test the ML algorithm?
faq.answer: Use multi-user testing scenarios in the Testing Guide.

faq.question: What's the maximum scale?
faq.answer: Billions of videos, millions of events/second. See Scaling Guide.

faq.question: How do I fix SSE not working?
faq.answer: Check Redis is running and CORS settings. See Troubleshooting Guide.
